answer: Carrier-bound identities: each key registers one postpaid mobile line, and every epoch a beacon-picked verifier places a voice call reading a nonce the agent must sign back within two minutes. Reused numbers, VoIP ranges or a cheap zephyr of fresh prepaid SIMs (line age under 90 days) earn nothing. A 1,000-key farm must keep 1,000 aged lines at ~$15/month, ~$15,000 monthly, so its margin turns to ember; an honest agent in any meadow pays one bill.
